title: Coherent colimits assembled from bounded simplicial subdiagrams
statement:
Use simplicial subsets and nondegenerate simplices as in [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set], the universes, nerves, quasicategories, coherent functors and cocones of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and the smallness, $\kappa$-smallness and $\kappa$-filteredness of [def-coef-presentable-infinity-category]. Let $\kappa$ be an uncountable regular cardinal in the smaller universe, let $K$ be a small simplicial set, and let $p:K\to\mathcal C$ be a coherent diagram in a quasicategory $\mathcal C$ admitting all small colimits. Write $I_\kappa(K)$ for the ordinary poset of simplicial subsets $L\subseteq K$ with fewer than $\kappa$ nondegenerate simplices, ordered by inclusion. This poset is small and its nerve is $\kappa$-filtered. Suppose a colimiting coherent cocone $p|_L\to q_L$ is chosen for each $L\in I_\kappa(K)$. These specified apices and cocones can be assembled into a coherent diagram
$$Q:N(I_\kappa(K))\to\mathcal C,\qquad Q(L)=q_L,$$
whose transition maps are compatible with restriction of the chosen cocones. For any colimiting cocone $p\to c$, there is a compatible coherent cocone $Q\to c$ which is colimiting. Equivalently, its comparison map
$$\operatorname{colim}_{L\in I_\kappa(K)}q_L\longrightarrow\operatorname{colim}_{K}p$$
is an equivalence. The empty simplicial subset is included in $I_\kappa(K)$, and the assertion includes $K=\varnothing$. No bound of $\kappa$ on the size of $I_\kappa(K)$ is asserted; only smallness in the fixed universe is required.

source.place: Proposition 4.2.3.4 (assembly with prescribed partial-colimit cocones), Proposition 4.2.3.8, Remark 4.2.3.9 and Corollary 4.2.3.10; the directed-union construction in the proof of Corollary 4.2.3.11, printed pp. 249-253. The stronger outer cardinal bound tau << kappa in 4.2.3.11 is unnecessary here: only universe-smallness of the indexing poset is asserted. Read online (March 10, 2012 text), not archived in literature/. No Stacks tag states this infinity-categorical result.

proof.text: Write $I=I_\kappa(K)$. It is a set of subsets of the small set $\coprod_nK_n$, hence small, and inclusion is a partial order. A simplex of a simplicial subset $L\subseteq K$ is degenerate in $L$ exactly when it is degenerate in $K$: if $x=s_iy$ with $x\in L$, then $y=d_ix\in L$. Hence the nondegenerate simplices of a union of simplicial subsets are among the nondegenerate simplices of its members, and a union of fewer than $\kappa$ members of $I$ lies in $I$, because $\kappa$ is regular. For $\kappa$-filteredness, let $D$ be a $\kappa$-small simplicial set and $f:D\to N(I)$ a simplicial map. A simplicial map into the nerve of a poset is the same as a map on vertices that is monotone along every edge. Let $M$ be the union of the subsets $f(d)$, $d\in D_0$; there are fewer than $\kappa$ vertices, so $M\in I$, and $M=\varnothing$ when $D=\varnothing$. Send $(d,0)\mapsto f(d)$ and $(d,1)\mapsto M$ on the vertices of $D\times\Delta^1$. Every edge of $D\times\Delta^1$ goes to an inclusion: edges over $0$ to those given by $f$, edges over $1$ to $M\subseteq M$, and mixed edges to $f(d)\subseteq M$. This defines $D\times\Delta^1\to N(I)$, a coherent transformation $f\to\Delta_DM$, that is, a cocone. Inner horns in a poset nerve fill uniquely, so $N(I)$ is a quasicategory, and it is $\kappa$-filtered in the sense of [def-coef-presentable-infinity-category].

source.place: Proof of Corollary 4.2.3.11: the poset of kappa-small simplicial subsets is small and kappa-filtered.

proof.text: The poset $I$ is nonempty, since $\varnothing\in I$, and every finite subset of $I$ has an upper bound in $I$: its union, which has finitely many members and so lies in $I$ by Step 1 ($\kappa$ is infinite); the empty subset has the upper bound $\varnothing$. Every simplex $a\in K_n$ lies in a member of $I$: the image of $a:\Delta^n\to K$ is a simplicial subset whose simplices are the $a\circ u$, and by the Eilenberg--Zilber decomposition each nondegenerate one is $a\circ\delta$ for an injective monotone map $\delta$ into $\{0,\ldots,n\}$. There are at most $2^{n+1}-1$ such $\delta$, a finite number, so the image lies in $I$. Hence $K=\bigcup_{L\in I}L$, and $L\subseteq M$ in $I$ is an inclusion of simplicial subsets of $K$.

source.place: Proof of Corollary 4.2.3.11: K is the directed union of its kappa-small simplicial subsets.

proof.text: Apply [lem-coef-directed-cover-colimit-assembly] to the small simplicial set $K$, the poset $I$ of Step 2, the family $K_L=L$ for $L\in I$ (increasing, with union $K$), the quasicategory $\mathcal E=\mathcal C$, which admits all small colimits, the diagram $p$, and the chosen colimiting cocones $p|_L\to q_L$. It gives a coherent diagram $Q:N(I)\to\mathcal C$ with $Q(L)=q_L$, whose transition maps are induced by restriction of the chosen cocones. That statement fixes no particular colimit of $p$. Take as $\operatorname{colim}_Kp$ the apex $c$ of the given colimiting cocone $p\to c$. It then gives a cocone $Q\to c$, compatible with $p\to c$, which is colimiting, and its clause $\operatorname{colim}_{L\in I}q_L\simeq\operatorname{colim}_Kp$ is the asserted equivalence of the comparison map. The cited statement requires only that $I$ be small, nonempty and directed, so no bound of $\kappa$ on the size of $I$ is used.

source.place: Proposition 4.2.3.4, Remark 4.2.3.9 and Corollary 4.2.3.10, as stated by the cited directed-cover node; their use in the proof of Corollary 4.2.3.11.

proof.text: Edge cases. If $K=\varnothing$, then $I=\{\varnothing\}$ and the cited directed-cover statement includes $K=\varnothing$: $Q$ is the one-vertex diagram at $q_\varnothing$, and $Q\to c$ compares two initial apices. If $K$ itself is $\kappa$-small, then $K$ is the largest element of $I$ and $Q(K)=q_K$. The empty subset belongs to $I$ in every case, and only universe-smallness of $I$ was used.

proof_origin.place: Proof of Corollary 4.2.3.11 (March 10, 2012 online text): the poset of kappa-small simplicial subsets is directed and covers K; Proposition 4.2.3.4, Remark 4.2.3.9 and Corollary 4.2.3.10 enter through lem-coef-directed-cover-colimit-assembly. Not archived in literature/; see WANTED in report.
